title: Fix Comment List Creation Functionality

requirements.text: Implement backend Motoko function to create a new comment list with a provided list ID, ensuring the list is persisted in the backend state and returns success confirmation

quotes: Build and fix both comment list creation and live list creation

acceptanceCriteria: Backend accepts a list ID string and creates a new CommentList record
Function returns success status after list creation
Duplicate list IDs are handled gracefully with error message
Created list appears in getAllCommentLists query results

requirements.text: Wire the 'Create New Comment List' section's 'Create' button to call the backend create function with the entered list ID from the input field
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Create' button triggers backend API call with input value
Input field is cleared after successful creation
Success toast notification displays 'Comment list created successfully'
Error toast displays if creation fails (e.g., duplicate ID)
Comment list dropdown in 'Manage Comments' section updates to include the new list

requirements.text: Display loading state on the 'Create' button while the backend request is in progress, and disable the button during submission to prevent duplicate requests
acceptanceCriteria: Button shows loading spinner or 'Creating...' text during API call
Button is disabled while request is in flight
Button returns to normal 'Create' state after completion

requirements.text: Validate that the list ID input field is not empty before allowing submission, displaying an error message if the user attempts to create a list without entering an ID
acceptanceCriteria: Empty input field prevents form submission
User sees validation error message: 'Please enter a list ID'
Button remains enabled but validation prevents API call

constraints: Maintain single-actor backend architecture with all logic in backend/main.mo
Use existing AdminCommentsTab.tsx component structure without breaking existing features
Preserve existing comment management features (lock, delete, add comments, upload file)
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or other immutable paths
Follow existing pattern in useAdminComments.ts for React Query hooks
nonGoals: Implementing Apps/Events (Live Lists) creation functionality (deferred to Build 2)
Adding username management features for Apps/Events
Modifying the visual design or layout of the Admin Panel
